topic: The rubbish bin on collection day.

episode.title: If Rubbish Bins Could Talk: Collection Day

shots.narration: Today's my big outing. Unless they forget me. Again.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon driveway outside a cosy modern house, unmarked rubbish truck visible down the street.
shots.action: A green wheeled rubbish bin with big hopeful eyes and a small mouth leans toward the distant truck.
shots.mood: Sunny morning, eager anticipation, bright cheerful colours.

shots.narration: I've been holding everyone's bad decisions all week.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of the green rubbish bin beside the garage, rubbish bags protruding beneath its lid.
shots.action: The green rubbish bin with big strained eyes and a small grimacing mouth struggles to close its lid over the bags.
shots.mood: Comically overstuffed, warm sunlight, playful frustration.

shots.narration: [surprised] That's my ride. Why am I still here?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, driveway foreground and residential street beyond, unmarked rubbish truck passing the entrance.
shots.action: The green rubbish bin with big alarmed eyes and a small open mouth watches the truck pass.
shots.mood: Sudden panic, exaggerated cartoon expression, sunny suburban setting.

shots.narration: Apparently, collection day requires me to collect my human.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, paved driveway leading to the house's plain front door.
shots.action: The green rubbish bin with big determined eyes and a small pursed mouth bumps against the front door.
shots.mood: Urgent slapstick, determined little hero, bright colours.

shots.narration: Nothing says dignity like being dragged outside in slippers.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, driveway sloping toward the kerb, only slippered feet and one hand visible beside the bin.
shots.action: A hand pulls the tilted green rubbish bin with big embarrassed eyes and a small tense mouth toward the kerb.
shots.mood: Flustered morning rush, cosy domestic comedy.

shots.narration: [excited] Finally! A chauffeur who appreciates my baggage.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, rear lifting mechanism of a stationary unmarked rubbish truck beside the kerb.
shots.action: The truck mechanism lifts the green rubbish bin with big delighted eyes and a small beaming mouth.

shots.narration: I haven't felt this empty since they bought reusable bags.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, rear hopper of the rubbish truck, bin held upside down above it.
shots.action: Rubbish tumbles from the inverted green bin with big relieved eyes and a small relaxed smile.
shots.mood: Satisfying release, harmless cartoon mess, bright clean rendering.

shots.narration: Lovely. My fresh start lasted one banana.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, green rubbish bin back beside the garage with its lid open.
shots.action: A banana peel drops into the green rubbish bin with big disbelieving eyes and a small downturned mouth.

shots.narration: [chuckles] My sponge needs therapy after this spa treatment.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, driveway washing area beside a plain bucket of soapy water.
shots.action: A gloved hand scrubs the dirty green bin's cheek with a yellow sponge, beside its big sheepish eyes and small awkward smile.
shots.mood: Cheerful sudsy mess, comic embarrassment, playful spa-day finish.

episode.endHook: Next episode: the sponge discusses its deeply regrettable career choice.
episode.description: One rubbish bin dreams of finally getting emptied—but getting to the kerb is only half the struggle. Collection day is its big outing, and somehow it still ends up needing a bath.
